existing_features.title: Create a simple landing page that helps the user describe what app they want to build, including a short guided form (e.g., app name, what it should do, target users, must-have features, nice-to-have features) and a submit action that shows a confirmation summary on screen.
Persist the submitted app idea in the backend canister and allow fetching the latest submitted idea from the frontend (single latest record is sufficient).
Apply a coherent visual theme across the UI (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling) suitable for an app-builder onboarding experience; avoid blue/purple as the primary palette.

projectName: Initial app starter with idea-capture flow
